code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    tops = {c: min(r for r in range(h) for col in range(w) if grid[r][col] == c) for c in colors}
    target = min(tops.values())
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for c in colors:
        shift = tops[c] - target
        for r in range(h):
            for col in range(w):
                if grid[r][col] == c:
                    out[r - shift][col] = c
    return out
'''
